मर mar-a, m. dying, death;
 world of death, 🞄earth: -ka, m. plague, epidemic.

मरिच marica, m. pepper-shrub;
 N..

मरीचिन् marīc-in, m. (radiant), sun.
मरुत marut-a, m. wind.
मरूभू marū-bhū, become a sandy waste.
मर्क 1. marká, m. eclipse of the sun (RV.¹).

मर्क 2. márka, m. N. of the Purohita of the 🞄Asuras;
 N. of a demon hostile to children.

मर्कट markáṭa, m. ape, monkey: ī, f. female 🞄ape;
 a-ka, m., i-kā, f. id..
मार्कट mārkaṭa, a. (ī) belonging to the 🞄monkey, ape-like.
मर्कटीभू markaṭī-bhū, turn into an ape.
मर्डितृ marḍ-i-tṛ́, m. shower of compassion, 🞄comforter (RV.).
मर्त már-ta, m. [old pp. of √ mṛ, preserving 🞄original strong vowel owing to early shifting 🞄of accent caused by change of meaning] 🞄mortal, man (V.).
मर्तव्य mar-tavya, fp. n. imps. one must die.
मर्दल mard-ala, m. kind of drum.

मर्मन् már-man, n. joint, exposed or vital part 🞄of the body;
 weak or vulnerable spot (fig.).

मर्मर mar-mar-a, a. rustling (leaves or garments);
 🞄m. rustling, murmur.
मर्मराज marma-rāja, m. N..

मर्मातिग marma‿atiga, a. penetrating deep 🞄into the joints or vitals, excruciating;
 -āvaraṇa, n. coat of mail.

मर्यादिन् maryād-in, m. frontier neighbour;
 🞄a. keeping within bounds.
मर्यादीकृ maryādī-kṛ, make a limit of, 🞄extend to (ac.).

मर्शन marś-ana, n. touching;
 investigating.
माररिपु māra-ripu, m. foe of the Devil, 🞄ep. of Śiva (Pr.).
मारव mārav-a, a. (ī) forming or situated 🞄in a desert (maru).
मारिका mār-ikā, f. plague, pestilence.
मारिष māriṣa, m. [perhaps turned back 🞄into Sanskrit from the Pāli mārisa = mādṛśa] 🞄worthy or excellent man (nearly always used 🞄in the vc. as a term of address = my worthy 🞄friend).

 m. mound to the right of the Vedi 🞄on which the sacrificial utensils are cleansed.

मार्डीक mārḍ-īká, n. [√ mṛd] compassion, 🞄mercy.

 statue 🞄of the sun-god: -maṇḍala, n. disc of the sun.
मार्तण्डीय mārtaṇḍ-īya, a. solar.

मार्त्तिक mārtti-ka, a. (ī) made of clay, 🞄earthen;
 n. earthenware vessel.
